description: Project-level Claude Code settings for the Yu-Gi-Oh GX Spirit Caller decomp. PostToolUse/PreToolUse hooks enforce ruff/test/invariants gates so the agent catches drift in-loop rather than at CI; the Stop hook is the framework adapter's convenience (2026-09-21) that mirrors each session's final reply into the shared completion-report inbox — see .claude/README.md; it is a convenience, not a control, and its absence means UNKNOWN, never that a task did not happen. Keep in sync with docs/decomp-workflow.md § Local setup extras. All three hooks now resolve their interpreter through .claude/hooks/run_python.sh (probes python3, then the Windows `py -3` launcher, then python) instead of a single hardcoded name, so tests/test_claude_hook_interpreter.py's one-interpreter invariant holds for a real reason rather than by coincidence. This does not by itself establish that Claude Code invokes hook commands through a POSIX shell on native Windows without WSL/Git Bash — see docs/queue/scaffolder.md's q-host-portability-sweep item E, still open.
